home.intro: Create a party, invite your friends and let the draw decide who buys a gift for whom.

health.title: Backend status
health.notConfigured: Backend is not configured (missing environment variables)

create.title: Create a party
create.accessCodeHint: Ask the person who runs this app for the code.

party.name: Party name
party.locationHint: Name of the place only, e.g. “Café Roma”
party.languageHint: Invitations and reminders are sent in this language. The budget currency follows it.

participants.title: Participants
participants.name: Name
participants.minHint: You need at least {{min}} participants (including you) to start the draw.

manage.linkHelp: Save this link: it is the only way to manage the party.
manage.emailSent: We also emailed it to you.
manage.emailNotSent: We could not email the link, so please copy it now.
manage.notFound: We could not find this party. Check that the link is complete.
manage.startedNote: Everyone has been emailed a private link. Matches and themes are secret, even from you.
manage.lockedNote: The draw is done, so participants can no longer be edited.

errors.theme_label_too_long: That theme name is too long.
errors.too_many_themes: You reached the limit of custom themes.
errors.theme_in_use: This theme is dealt to someone. You can remove it after the next redo.
errors.duplicate_email: This email is already in the list.
errors.past_event: The party must be in the future.
errors.invalid_access_code: That access code is not correct.
errors.daily_limit: The daily limit of new parties has been reached. Try again tomorrow.
errors.locked: This party has already started and can no longer be edited.
errors.not_found: We could not find this party.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.not_configured: The app is not connected to its backend.
errors.server_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.cannot_start: The party can't be started yet. Check the warning above the button.
errors.conflict: The participants changed while starting. Please try again.
errors.event_passed: The event date has passed, so this can no longer be done.

matching.title: Matching
matching.sameGenderHint: Everyone needs a gender set. Girls only get girls, boys only get boys.

themes.title: Gift themes
themes.hint: Each participant gets one unique theme as a hint for their gift.
themes.customHint: Up to {{max}} custom themes. They look the same in every language.

start.dialogBody: This draws names and emails all {{count}} participants. Matches stay secret, even from you, and can't be changed afterwards.

issues.too_few_participants: Add at least {{min}} participants to start (you have {{count}}).
issues.missing_gender: Same-gender matching needs a gender for everyone. Missing for: {{names}}.
issues.group_too_small: The "{{group}}" group has only one person, so they can't be matched within it. Add someone to that group or switch to mixed matching.

reveal.buyingFor: You are buying a gift for
reveal.secret: Keep this a secret. Only you can see this page.
reveal.notFound: This link is not valid. Ask the organizer to resend your invite.
reveal.remadeBody: Your previous match and theme are no longer valid. This is your new result.
reveal.tapHint: Make sure nobody is looking over your shoulder.

redo.title: Redo the draw
redo.intro: Remake all matches and themes. You can still adjust the matching mode and gift themes below. Everyone keeps their private link and is emailed about the new draw.
redo.dialogBody: This replaces all matches and themes for all {{count}} participants and emails everyone. Previous matches stop being valid.
redo.done: The draw was remade and everyone was emailed.
redo.eventPassed: The event date has passed, so the draw can no longer be redone.
